evals.prompt: Can you critically analyze this paper for me? I need to understand the methodology strengths and weaknesses. https://doi.org/10.1038/nature12373
evals.expected_output: A structured critical summary table with all 7 steps completed: Aerial View (overview, research question, knowledge gap), Interrogation (methodology assessment, independent conclusion), Verdict (reconciliation, alternative explanations), plus Summary Assessment, Strengths, Weaknesses, and Quick Takeaway sections.
assertions: Output contains Summary Assessment section with quality ratings (Overall Quality, Methodological Rigor, etc.)
Output contains Phase 1: Aerial View with paper overview, research question, and knowledge gap
Output contains Phase 2: Interrogation with methodology assessment table (at least 3 dimensions rated)
Output contains Phase 3: Verdict with reconciliation and alternative explanations
Output contains Strengths section with at least 2 bullet points
Output contains Weaknesses section with at least 2 bullet points
Output contains Quick Takeaway section
Output uses structured table format with markdown tables
